title: The Future of Tax and Finance in UK Banking: AI, Automation, Governance and the New Compliance Landscape
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Finance and tax functions across UK banking are entering a period of significant change. Regulatory requirements continue to evolve, digital reporting and e-invoicing are reshaping compliance internationally, and AI is creating new opportunities to automate processes, improve insight and rethink how finance teams operate. At the same time, banks must balance innovation with increasing expectations around governance, data security, regulatory accountability and operational resilience.


**But what does this mean in practice for financial institutions operating in an already complex VAT and compliance environment?**


Join UK Finance, Vertex and Oracle for a practical discussion exploring how tax, finance and technology leaders can prepare for the next phase of financial transformation. We'll consider the implications of AI and automation, the changing digital tax and e-invoicing landscape, and why strong tax data, controls and governance are critical as finance processes become more automated. We'll also explore how banks can improve VAT recovery at a systemic level by embedding tax intelligence, controls and automation directly within finance and procurement processes.
